speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The shop is shut, brother. I can take it tonight, and the carrier is in tomorrow. You will be busy dying at about a quarter to three, which is a poor hour for Carter Lane.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Then you take it. Sixty shillings, sewn in canvas, and I am not opening the seam to admire them. They are for Stratford. They are not a speech.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I can carry a seam. I carry ribbon all day, and ribbon is fussier than coin. Where is the letter that goes with it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Four lines, and they are not written up into a chapter. The king is played Thursday. More when I know whether anybody came. That is the news. The tooth is not news. She knows I have one.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Four lines will sit on top of the canvas and not frighten the horse. You look as if the clove is doing more work than the poet. Say your England, if you must say it, and then give me the packet.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Is he sorry to leave it, sir, or sorry for it?

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: Both.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Then say it sorrier at the end.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I will say it sorrier at the end. That is a direction I can keep, and I have kept fewer this week than a boy of your sense would believe.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I only heard the end of it, sir. This England. It sounded as if the man was being put out of doors. I did not mean to correct a play. I meant to understand a sentence.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: You understood it better than a gallery will, and you did it for nothing. Brother, if the yard is half as quick as the washing, you may have a Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The yard will have what it has. I am not promising a triumph to a man who is about to walk my money across the City. Take the canvas. Take the four lines. Do not take a prophecy with them.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse! Not after eight.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: I am going, mistress. I only asked which sorrow it was. He said both, and I told him to be sorrier, and I think that was the whole of my harm.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Your harm is being on the stair after the house has closed its ears. Down. Master Gilbert may stay until the packet is in his hand and no longer.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: The packet is in my hand. I know the Bell, and I know Hobbins will have it in the morning. You need not walk, brother. Dying is quite enough employment for a Thursday.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: I am not walking. The rehearsal on the book can do without me, and the Bell can do without me, and you can do with both errands by being the brother who still has an evening.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: If it fails, brother, there's always ribbon.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: If it fails I will come and cut ribbon, and the tooth will be glad of a quieter trade. It will not fail for lack of a carrier. That part, at least, I have given to a man who keeps a seam.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: Good night, sir. Say it sorrier. I will not be there to hear, and that is why I said it now.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Alse. The stair.

speaker: alse_pinder
text: The stair, mistress. Good night, Master Gilbert. Do not drop the England. It is only coin, but he sewed it as if it were a line.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: I will not drop it. Brother, the four lines. If you add a fifth at the door I will leave the fifth on the post, and Anne will have a very short mystery.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: No fifth. The king on Thursday. More when I know whether anybody came. If nobody came, the more will be short, and she has survived short letters before.

speaker: gilbert_shakespeare
text: Then I am gone. God keep you. Try to be alive at a quarter to three, whatever the play prefers. Mother would take it ill if the carrier outlived the poet by a speech.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: God keep you. Tell them the money is the Michaelmas money, and that the king is a king and not a secret. I am too tired to be mysterious, and the canvas is as plain as a loaf.

speaker: dorcas_ansell
text: Shut the door after him. And you, Master Shakespeare, may put the clove away if the speech is over. I will not have the house smelling of a rehearsal past eight.

speaker: william_shakespeare
text: The speech is over for tonight. The sorrier ending is saved for the yard, where Alse cannot fine me for it. The door is shut.
